card.main_question: Describe a piece of technology that has changed your life.
bullets: when and how you started using it
and explain how it has changed your life

evaluation_criteria.FC: 需要在 1.5-2 分钟内连续描述，避免长停顿；用时序连接词（at first / later on / nowadays）组织 4 个 bullet
evaluation_criteria.LR: 建议词汇：cutting-edge, indispensable, streamline, ubiquitous, transformative, revolutionize, paradigm shift, double-edged sword
evaluation_criteria.GRA: 适合展示 present perfect（has changed / have been using）、relative clauses、被动语态描述功能

sample_answer.text: Well, the piece of technology I'd like to talk about is my smartphone — specifically, the iPhone I've been using for about four years now. I got it as a graduation gift from my parents, and honestly, at first I just used it for the basics, you know, calls and texts. But over time it's become pretty much indispensable to my daily routine. Nowadays I use it for, well, almost everything — managing my schedule, learning English through apps, even paying for groceries. What's really changed my life is how it's blurred the line between work and personal time. On one hand, I can stay connected with my students after class and answer their questions instantly, which has made me a more responsive teacher. On the other hand, I sometimes find it hard to switch off, and I'll catch myself checking notifications at midnight. So it's a bit of a double-edged sword, but overall I'd say it's transformed how I work, learn, and stay in touch with the people I care about.
cohesive_devices: on one hand / on the other hand

common_errors.error: 用 'I am using my phone for 4 years' 代替 present perfect continuous
common_errors.fix: 改为 'I've been using my phone for 4 years'

common_errors.error: 把 'technology' 当可数名词说 'a technology'（除非指具体设备）
common_errors.fix: 整体概念用 'technology'，具体设备用 'a piece of technology / a device'

common_errors.error: 用 'It changes my life' 而不是 'It has changed my life'（题目用了 has changed）
common_errors.fix: 和题目时态保持一致，用 present perfect

common_errors.error: 4 个 bullet 只答 3 个（最常漏掉最后的 explain how）
common_errors.fix: 做答前先在心里复述 4 个 bullet，每个至少 25-30 秒

common_errors.error: 范文中用 'very important' / 'very useful' 这种 7.0 以下词汇
common_errors.fix: 替换为 indispensable / pivotal / instrumental 等 band 7.5+ 词汇
